scenes.title: Sorbonne ISIR CoVR Haptic Arena
scenes.reference_notes: Official laboratory page and its installed apparatus photograph reviewed. Overhead black gantry rails supported by tall metal columns. Suspended tall plywood prop with two circular openings. Floor arena marked with tape, perimeter benches with shelves and exposed ceiling services. Single real arena photograph; room dimensions, overhead load rating and motion limits not published. Exclude people and reproduce mechanical positioning only, without claims about perception or haptic fidelity.
observed_cues: Overhead black gantry rails supported by tall metal columns.
Suspended tall plywood prop with two circular openings.
Floor arena marked with tape, perimeter benches with shelves and exposed ceiling services.

support.evidence: Continuous floor columns; EPFL stands extend through the open grate to the lower structural slab

scenes.title: EPFL LWE Anechoic Inspection Room
scenes.institution: Laboratory of Wave Engineering — Acoustic Anechoic Room
scenes.reference_notes: Official laboratory page and its installed apparatus photograph reviewed. Walls and ceiling covered by alternating horizontal and vertical deep pale acoustic wedges. Raised metal mesh walking floor reveals lower void. Circular apparatus-support fixtures project through the floor near the perimeter. Room footprint is not surveyed; one-metre absorber depth is published, but individual wedge widths and floor height require estimation. No acoustic propagation, chamber certification or measurement accuracy is simulated.
